response: To maintain the integrity of your chimney stack, it's important to repoint it regularly. This involves cleaning and resealing the mortar to prevent leaks and improve efficiency. A new layer of mortar should be applied, ensuring a smooth and secure fit. The use of high-quality materials will help extend the life of the chimney. For added protection, consider installing an awning to shield the stack from weather elements. Gravel can be used as a base to improve drainage and prevent water accumulation. Regular maintenance will ensure the chimney remains safe and efficient for years to come.
